title: Calculate time beyond a booking
prompt: Write public static double ExtraHours(double hours, double included). Both inputs are zero or more. Return the hours beyond the included amount, or 0 when the booking covers everything.
hints: Think about a booking that is larger than the time used.
Decide what to return when all the time is covered.
On the other path, return only the part beyond the included hours.
checkLabels: A booking larger than the time used must give 0.
Using exactly the included hours must give 0.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Returns a negative amount when the booking covers everything.
Returns all the hours once the booking is passed.

feedback: Try a booking that is larger than the time used, then one that is smaller. The result is never below 0.
